title: ContractVille
provenance: Reported by ObT1337 (highball#202, 2026-09-25), Apple M1, macOS 15.6.1, Highball 0.9.35, engine x64-sikarugir10.0_6-r7, DXVK: the logos play, then a black screen, later confirmed on an M2 with the full game. Verified by the maintainer on 2026-09-26 on an M1 Pro, macOS 27.0: the same install loads and reaches the character creator on the Wine 11 engines r11 (seen on screen, DXVK and DXMT) and r12 (process profile, DXMT), and never leaves its loading screen on the Wine 10 engine r7.
notes: Unreal Engine 4.27. Needs the Wine 11 engine (x64-crossover26.3-r12, the recipe names it) and DXMT. On the default Wine 10 engine the game sits on its loading screen forever after the logos, game running, nothing loading, Epic's SDK idle, on DXVK and with or without Media Foundation, measured for 20 minutes on an M1 Pro. On the Wine 11 tree the same install plays its intros, shows a loading screen with a progress bar and reaches the character creator in about five minutes. DXMT draws it fully. DXVK on Wine 11 gets there too but draws the character preview black. DXMT on the Wine 10 engine crashes at start (D3D11 CreateTexture2D with the shared flag returns E_FAIL on DXMT 0.80). Gameplay past the character creator was not exercised and no frame rate was read. Why the Wine 10 tree stalls is open.

knownIssues.symptom: Endless loading screen after the logos on the default engine (reported on an M1 and an M2, reproduced on an M1 Pro, engine r7).
knownIssues.cause: the Wine 10 tree. The game's startup stops before its Epic login and nothing loads. Not the videos, not the renderer. The same install loads on the Wine 11 tree.
knownIssues.fix: move the environment to the Wine 11 engine (Settings, Environments, the environment's page, Advanced, engine Wine 11.0 (CrossOver 26.3) r12) and use the DXMT mode. The recipe names both, so a Highball with it offers the engine on Play.

knownIssues.symptom: Character preview drawn black in the character creator on DXVK (Wine 11, M1 Pro).
knownIssues.cause: not measured, DXVK on MoltenVK with this game's preview render target.

knownIssues.symptom: Crashes at start on DXMT with the Unreal crash reporter on the Wine 10 engine (M1 Pro, engine r7, DXMT 0.80).
knownIssues.cause: measured: a shared D3D11 render target (MISC_SHARED, R16G16B16A16_FLOAT) gets E_FAIL from that DXMT build, which Unreal treats as fatal.
knownIssues.fix: the Wine 11 engine, whose DXMT accepts it.

dxmt.detail: on the Wine 11 engines r11 and r12: character creator with the 3D scene (M1 Pro, 2026-09-26). On the Wine 10 engine r7: crash at start, shared texture E_FAIL

dxvk.detail: on Wine 11 r11 the game loads and the creator works but the character preview is black. On the Wine 10 engine r7 the loading screen never ends
